selection_disclosure: V4 changes only deterministic coverage capacity after the storage architecture was repaired: 48 candidates, 128 tokens and four public CLOB shards instead of 16/48/two. It does not alter the payoff compiler, rule certifier, fee stress, edge hurdle, budget, orphan-risk rule or ranking from observed PnL. Every V1-V3 evaluation is excluded from V4 evidence by the content-addressed universe identifier and fresh v11 epoch.
hypothesis: A wider deterministic panel of venue-rule-certified payoff identities will expose additional small-capacity executable locks without relaxing proof or execution standards.

accepted: non-augmented explicit negRisk complete event sets
same-scope sports total and spread ladders with identical normalized rule templates
fail_closed: unknown rule documents, fee schedules, venue minimums or payoff states
certification.payoff_verifier: deterministic finite-state proof; no AI output can certify a bundle
certification.identity: universe version, legs, payoff proof and rule-certification hash

coverage.selection: deterministic round-robin across complete sets, sports totals, sports spreads, nested thresholds, disjoint ranges and binary controls
coverage.gamma_views: end-time and volume panels plus explicit sports taxonomy

execution.book_model: walk every displayed ask level on every leg
execution.fees: current per-market metadata stressed at 2x; unknown schedules fail closed
execution.orphan_rule: no multi-leg candidate is qualified unless worst-case non-atomic orphan stress passes

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across relation class, latency profile and capacity band
evaluation.null_outcome: No executable certified bundle is an acceptable and reportable result.
